author: RichestsoftSukhbir
description: Pill white button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #121212 to #fff, bottom becomes 0, border-radius becomes 0.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Big Liger 46</title>
<style>
/* Big Liger 46 by RichestsoftSukhbir — https://uiverse.io/RichestsoftSukhbir/big-liger-46 */
.button {
  padding: 12px 25px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #121212;
  color: #121212;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.5s ease;
}
.button::after {
  content: "";
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #121212;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -100%;
  left: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: all 0.5s ease;
}
.button:hover {
  color: #fff;
}
.button:hover::after {
  bottom: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">Hover Over Me</button>

</body>
</html>
